Fantastic little bar, great staff and an amazing owner - a must visit place in Hà Nội
Sep 2025 • Couples
Stumbled across this place on our first night completely by accident and we visited multiple times across a few days. The small bar has a good selection of beers and spirits and the staff are very friendly. The owner, Stefan, was absolutely amazing, giving us recommendations for drinks, local advice and gave us his card for us to contact him with any queries we may have about our stay in South East Asia. Would highly recommend.

You've got to visit!
Jan 2025 • Couples
Loved, loved, loved this place! Small but perfectly formed. 🥰 
Stefano is the ultimate host, so welcoming and full of stories and chat. Cocktails to die for, can certainly recommend the house cocktail which varies with the season. Beers you will not have heard of or tried before, at varying strengths!
The sort of place you think you'll pop in for a drink and then never want to leave. Just go steady climbing down from the bar stool after a few drinks. 😃 
We wish Stefan all the success in the world and also look forward to trying the Romania wine selections recommended when we finally get home. Cheers 🍻 👏

Little Tipsy with Class
Jul 2024 • Family
What a great place. Stefan and his wife are warm and generous hosts. Stefan made some fab cocktail suggestions - a great Old Cuban for us and a fresh and juicy mocktail for the teenagers. Stefan is a true example of success overcoming adversity in life and has brought just the right touch of elegant Europeanism to Hanoi.
We left to have dinner - but had to go back for one more Old Cuban ♥️
